implementation.cancellation: When no terminal cancellation receipt exists, ci_check reads the cancelled marker only to select an exceptional path. A cancelled marker is not proof: request/manifest matching and run_cancellation._stopped perform the full stop check. STOP_UNCONFIRMED remains incomplete (exit 2), and stopped-but-unfinalized remains NOT_FINALIZED. Normal non-cancelled CI does not scan the full resource snapshot.
implementation.exit_semantics: EVIDENCE_REVOKED is a completed rejection (exit 1, use=false); STOP_UNCONFIRMED is an incomplete gate (exit 2, use=false). Existing finalized cancellation handling remains receipt-gated (exit 3).
